source_uncertainties: Publisher captions fully read. Title cards number uploads38/39; manifest32A/B retained in navigation. Media deliberately deleted before author run; no playback/recovery performed or claimed.

L32A f0065 normal-momentum transverse-viscous coefficient is written(1/Re)(delta^2/L^2), inconsistent with dimensional normal equation and continuity scaling. Chapter rederives coefficient(1/Re)(L^2/delta_s^2). Pressure-uniformity conclusion remains valid; normal transverse diffusion is order1 after division by epsilon U^2/L, not small as spoken.

L32A f0072 surface-coordinate writing is unclear x/y_s; stationary flat-wall condition translated to y=0. Board f0078 and earlier f0072 vector99%edge condition is replaced with scalar Vx99%definition; true matching is asymptotic,normal velocity not prescribed0 at edge.
L32A f0086 uses eta=y/delta and f=Vx/U; chapter uses eta=y sqrt(U/(nu x)) and F streamfunction,with explicit conversion eta_board=eta/eta99 and f_board=Fprime.
L32A captions call rho U^2 dynamic pressure; chapter uses conventional half rho U^2 inCf. Normalized pressure scale rho U^2 explicitly defined without misnaming it.

No precise transition threshold,aircraft fuel saving,quantified roughness law,measured cylinder separation angle or golf-ball drag used. Lecture0.35/0.072/one-seventh turbulent fits retained as qualified lecture empirical approximations with no supplied validity interval;not independently validated.

L32B f0028 integral equation actually reads tau_w/rho=d(U^2 theta)/dx+delta_star U Uprime. Caption phrase del square u corrected from board. Original von Karman paper unconsulted; chapter derivation is original.
L32B statement at zero shear that Vx does not change with y is qualified:only first derivative vanishes at wall,not entire profile. Smooth Taylor expansion explains this.

Prandtl original German1904 and Blasius original German1908 not read;English NACA452/1256 pages actually viewed. Original Blasius series method differs from new RK4/bisection computation;no computer claim made for1908.
Scaling delta_s,conventionaldelta99,displacementdelta_star,momentumtheta_m and nominal turbulentdelta_t kept distinct. theta_m avoids angle/temperatureTheta collision;w not reused for velocity.

Raw/private sources remain outside deliverable repo. Author visual checks use private SVG-to-PDF-to-PNG renders,not browser validation.Independent review and lead browser/math rendering remain pending.
